entries.source: *It got away...*
entries.translation: *它跑掉了……*

entries.source: *Not even a nibble...*
entries.translation: *连一口都没咬到……*

entries.source: *You got it!*
entries.translation: *钓到了！*

entries.source: Try to catch a fish?
entries.translation: 要试着钓鱼吗？

entries.source:
*Oops!
The fishing rod broke!*
entries.translation:
*糟糕！
鱼竿断了！*

entries.source:
I made these circlets myself.
Do you like them?
entries.translation:
这些花环都是我亲手做的。
你喜欢吗？

entries.source: Thank you!
entries.translation: 谢谢你！

entries.source:
Ah, hello there!
Have you seen any bunnies around?
entries.translation:
啊，你好！
你有看到附近有什么兔子吗？

entries.source:
You haven't?
Do you think you will see
some on your adventure?
Can I join you?
entries.translation:
没有吗？
你觉得冒险时会遇到
一些兔子吗？
我能和你一起走吗？

entries.source:
Even for all the bunnies
in the meadow, I wouldn't
join forces with an owl. Apologies.
entries.translation:
就算草地上有所有的兔子，
我也不会
和猫头鹰联手。抱歉。

entries.source:
Even for all the bunnies
in the meadow, I wouldn't
join forces with a squirrel. Apologies.
entries.translation:
就算草地上有所有的兔子，
我也不会
和松鼠联手。抱歉。

entries.source: No? That's a pity...
entries.translation: 没有吗？真可惜……

entries.source:
Fantastic!
I love the scent of
an adventure ahead!
entries.translation:
太棒了！
我喜欢前方
冒险的气息！

entries.source:
*sniff sniff*
I found treasure!
entries.translation:
*嗅嗅……*
我发现了宝藏！

entries.source:
Oh my!
It feels so good to stretch my legs again.
I've been cooped up as a frog for so long!
entries.translation:
天哪！
重新伸展双腿的感觉真好。
我被困在青蛙身体里太久了！

entries.source:
I cannot begin to express my gratitude.
Your bravery and kindness shine
brighter than the sun.
entries.translation:
我无法用言语表达我的感激。
你的勇气与善良
比太阳还要耀眼。

entries.source:
Please, allow me to
gift you something special,
a token of my appreciation.
entries.translation:
请允许我
送你一件特别的礼物，
以表谢意。

entries.source: You are my hero!
entries.translation: 你是我的英雄！

entries.source:
Thank you.
Your name shall be remembered in our
kingdom's tales of heroism and bravery.
entries.translation:
谢谢你。
你的名字会被铭记在我们王国
英勇无畏的传说中。

entries.source: Give it a kiss
entries.translation: 给它一个吻

entries.source:
What to do
with this frog?
entries.translation:
该怎么处理
这只青蛙？

entries.source:
Want to play a game?
You can win some Ethereal Dice!
entries.translation:
想玩个游戏吗？
你可以赢得一些幽灵骰子！

entries.source:
He-he-he!
Perfect, let's play!
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿！
太好了，我们来玩吧！

entries.source:
Oh!?
But what's life without
a little fun, right?
He-he-he!
entries.translation:
哦！？
不过人生没有一点乐趣
又有什么意思，对吧？
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
Ah sorry,
I don't feel like playing anymore right now.
entries.translation:
啊，抱歉，
我现在不想再玩了。

entries.source:
You win!
He-he-he!
We should play again...
entries.translation:
你赢了！
嘿嘿嘿！
我们下次再玩……

entries.source:
I win!
No dice for you, he-he-he!
We should play again!
entries.translation:
我赢了！
没有骰子给你，嘿嘿嘿！
我们下次再玩！

entries.source: Rub the magic lamp?
entries.translation: 要擦拭魔法灯吗？

entries.source:
Master,
I shall fulfil one wish,
what do you wish for?
entries.translation:
主人，
我会实现一个愿望，
你想要什么？

entries.source: So shall it be.
entries.translation: 如你所愿。

entries.source:
My work is done here,
continue onwards, master.
entries.translation:
我的工作完成了，
继续前进吧，主人。

entries.source: Try to snatch the Pearl Ring?
entries.translation: 要抢走珍珠戒指吗？

entries.source:
*Ouch!
Not quick enough!*
entries.translation:
*哎哟！
动作不够快！*

entries.source: *Got it!*
entries.translation: *拿到了！*

entries.source:
Well, well, isn't this
a peculiar predicament?
From one cage-rattler
to another, salutations!
entries.translation:
哎呀，哎呀，这真是
个奇怪的处境啊？
从一个摇笼子的人
向另一个摇笼子的人致意！

entries.source:
I will not lie to you.
Yes, I am a devil.
Now, don't jump to
quick conclusions.
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
entries.translation:
我不会骗你。
是的，我是恶魔。
不过别急着
下结论。
咩——嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
While this cage isn't
my ideal setting, it doesn't
impede my talent for...
intriguing negotiations.
entries.translation:
虽然这座牢笼
不是我理想的处所，
却丝毫不妨碍我
进行……有趣的谈判。

entries.source:
Let's chat, shall we?
I'm sure we can figure something out.
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
entries.translation:
我们聊聊吧？
我相信我们能想出办法。
咩——嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
No? Well that's a shame.
If you change your mind
remember: you are always welcome.
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
entries.translation:
不了？真遗憾。
如果你改变主意，
记住：随时欢迎你。
咩——嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source: Yes. Let's see...
entries.translation: 好吧。让我看看……

entries.source:
Now that wasn't that bad, huh?
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
Pleasure making business.
entries.translation:
这没那么糟，对吧？
咩——嘿嘿嘿！
很高兴和你做成这笔交易。

entries.source:
My deal stands as it is.
Come back any time
if you change your mind.
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
entries.translation:
我的条件不变。
你改变主意的话
随时可以回来。
咩——嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source: So be it!
entries.translation: 就这样吧！

entries.source:
While my situation might
look quite dire.
It looks like you aren't doing
too well either.
entries.translation:
虽然我的处境看起来
可能相当糟糕，
但看来你的状况
也不太好。

entries.source:
For the measly amount of
ALL your souls, I'd be glad
to fully heal you!
How about that?
entries.translation:
只要你全部的
灵魂，我就很乐意
把你彻底治好！
怎么样？

entries.source:
You are quite strong, huh?
You seem to have grown a lot.
But you haven't reached your
full potential yet, huh?
entries.translation:
你很强嘛，对吧？
你似乎成长了不少。
但你还没达到
自己的极限，对吧？

entries.source:
For the measly amount of
ALL your souls, I'd be glad
to level you up to the point
of reaching your next breakpoint?
How about that?
entries.translation:
只要你全部的
灵魂，我就很乐意
帮你升级到
下一个突破点？
怎么样？

entries.source:
Let's take a look
at your weapon...
Oh my, oh my...
not the best quality, huh?
entries.translation:
让我看看
你的武器……
哎呀，哎呀……
品质不太好，对吧？

entries.source:
For the measly amount of
ALL your souls, I'd be glad
to bestow a new legendary weapon upon you!
How about that?
entries.translation:
只要你全部的
灵魂，我就很乐意
赐予你一件新的传说级武器！
怎么样？

entries.source:
You look pretty well set.
I have an idea for a simple
but classic deal!
entries.translation:
你看起来准备得很充分。
我有个简单
却经典的交易点子！

entries.source:
For the measly amount of
ALL your souls, I'd be glad
to revive you once from death!
How about that?
entries.translation:
只要你全部的
灵魂，我就很乐意
让你起死回生一次！
怎么样？

entries.source:
Your weapon seems
mighty fine...
but barely upgraded.
Meh-eh-eh-eh!
entries.translation:
你的武器看起来
相当不错……
但几乎没有升级。
咩——嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
For the measly amount of
ALL your souls, I'd be glad to upgrade your weapon to level 4!
How about that?
entries.translation:
只要你全部的
灵魂，我就很乐意把你的武器升级到4级！
怎么样？

entries.source: Examine the golden tree?
entries.translation: 要调查金色的树吗？

entries.source: Investigate the corpse?
entries.translation: 要调查尸体吗？

entries.source:
I collect souls for the high heavens!
Everything's for sale!
entries.translation:
我替至高天堂收集灵魂！
什么都有得卖！

entries.source:
I hope you brought
plenty of souls!
entries.translation:
希望你带了
足够多的灵魂！

entries.source:
What do you think about
our heavenly wares?
entries.translation:
你觉得
我们的天界货物怎么样？

entries.source:
I collect souls for
the master.
Need anything?
entries.translation:
我替
主人收集灵魂。
需要什么吗？

entries.source:
I hope you brought
a bunch of souls!
Nee hee hee hee!
entries.translation:
希望你带了
一大把灵魂！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Quite hot down here, huh?
Nee hee hee hee!
entries.translation:
这里很热，对吧？
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source: "Here rests a once powerful hero."
entries.translation: “这里安眠着一位曾经强大的英雄。”

entries.source:
"They fought valiantly
to protect the innocent."
entries.translation:
“他们曾英勇奋战
保护无辜者。”

entries.source:
*Hearing about the heroes legacy,
fills you with Determination.
entries.translation:
*听闻英雄的遗志，
你充满了决心。

entries.source:
Hey, want to play a game?
For the low price of <color=yellow>5 Gold<sprite name="Gold"></color> you can
win some superb trash I've collected!
entries.translation:
嘿，要玩个游戏吗？
只要低价支付<color=yellow>5金币<sprite name="Gold"></color>，
就能赢走我收集的绝妙垃圾！

entries.source:
Yeehaw! Let's play!
He-he-he!
entries.translation:
耶！来玩吧！
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
Don't you like fun?
That's odd.
entries.translation:
你不喜欢乐趣吗？
真奇怪。

entries.source:
I'm all out of stuff
for you to win.
He-he-he!
entries.translation:
我已经没有
东西可以让你赢了。
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
I win!
That means I get to keep my stuff.
He-he-he!
entries.translation:
我赢了！
这下我的东西归我了。
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
Lucky you!
Let's see...
Here, take this!
entries.translation:
你真走运！
让我看看……
来，拿着！

entries.source:
Attempt to finish
the ice sculpture?
entries.translation:
要试着完成
冰雕吗？

entries.source: *That didn't go so well..*
entries.translation: *好像不太顺利……*

entries.source:
*You finished the last
ice sculpture*
entries.translation:
*你完成了最后一座
冰雕*

entries.source:
*You feel an icy wind
blow through the caverns.*
entries.translation:
*你感到一阵冰冷的风
吹过洞窟。*

entries.source:
*The goddess of Winter
seems satisfied.*
entries.translation:
*冬之女神
似乎很满意。*

entries.source: Take a sip of ichor?
entries.translation: 要喝一口灵液吗？

entries.source:
*A hint of strawberry!
If only you could remember
what a strawberry tastes like...*
entries.translation:
*一丝草莓味！
要是你还记得
草莓是什么味道就好了……*

entries.source:
*A sharp aftertaste,
surprisingly refreshing!*
entries.translation:
*强烈的回味，
意外地清爽！*

entries.source:
*The forbidden nectar of the gods.
What a yummy snack!*
entries.translation:
*神明的禁忌甘露。
真是美味的点心！*

entries.source: *Tastes like victory!*
entries.translation: *尝起来像胜利！*

entries.source: Greetings, keen traveler!
entries.translation: 你好，敏锐的旅人！

entries.source:
Will you take my offspring
on a magnificent adventure?
entries.translation:
你愿意带我的孩子
去一场壮丽的冒险吗？

entries.source:
I have a lot of trust in you.
Fare well and take care!
entries.translation:
我非常信任你。
一路顺风，保重！

entries.source:
I see you've decided for another.
That is fine, I shall wait for an
even smarter traveler!
entries.translation:
我看出你选择了另一个。
没关系，我会等待
更聪明的旅人！

entries.source: Touch the strange crystal?
entries.translation: 要触碰这枚奇异的水晶吗？

entries.source:
*You have been blessed
by the power of the pylon.*
entries.translation:
*你受到了
石柱之力的祝福。*

entries.source: *You gained [[+3]] Magic Find<sprite name="Magic_Find">.*
entries.translation: *你获得了[[+3]]寻宝率<sprite name="Magic_Find">。*

entries.source: Investigate the statue of a knight?
entries.translation: 要调查骑士雕像吗？

entries.source: I fish for food!
entries.translation: 我钓鱼是为了食物！

entries.source:
Do you fish too?
Need any tips?
entries.translation:
你也钓鱼吗？
需要一些诀窍吗？

entries.source:
We love gold.
Gold so shiny!
You know!?
entries.translation:
我们喜欢金子。
金子真闪亮！
知道吗！？

entries.source:
We love food.
Gold is nice,
but cannot fill belly!
You know?!
entries.translation:
我们喜欢食物。
金子很好，
但填不饱肚子！
知道吗？！

entries.source:
We love community.
Makes little folk strong!
You know?!
entries.translation:
我们喜欢团结。
小个子也能因此变强！
知道吗？！

entries.source:
Need more?
I have more.
entries.translation:
还要更多吗？
我还有。

entries.source:
Hmm, I make this again,
strangers love this.
entries.translation:
嗯，我再做一个，
陌生人喜欢这个。

entries.source:
Psshd!
Don't tell other Kobolds!
entries.translation:
嘘！
别告诉其他狗头人！

entries.source:
I like to come here to drink!
Yes yes!
entries.translation:
我喜欢来这里喝酒！
是的，是的！

entries.source: Makes feel fuzzy!
entries.translation: 喝了会让人飘飘然！

entries.source:
Tavernkeep a very nice man!
So nice indeed!
entries.translation:
酒馆老板是个很好的人！
真的非常好！

entries.source: We craft and sell.
entries.translation: 我们制作并出售。

entries.source:
Ok...
I craft and other kobold sell.
entries.translation:
好吧……
我负责制作，其他狗头人负责出售。

entries.source:
Interested in fresh catch?
I keep most for me.
Very delicious!
entries.translation:
对新鲜捕获物感兴趣吗？
大部分我会留给自己。
非常美味！

entries.source:
I catch what I find.
Very tasty!
entries.translation:
我抓到什么就卖什么。
非常美味！

entries.source:
The sea provides.
Food good for you!
entries.translation:
大海会提供一切。
食物对你有好处！

entries.source: My favorite...
entries.translation: 我最喜欢的……

entries.source: So tasty!
entries.translation: 真好吃！

entries.source:
*The lever
is already activated.*
entries.translation:
*拉杆
已经启动了。*

entries.source:
*Better not touch
anything anymore...*
entries.translation:
*最好别再碰
任何东西了……*

entries.source:
*It seems all
levers reset...*
entries.translation:
*看来所有
拉杆都重置了……*

entries.source:
*There is a hidden lever.
Flip it?*
entries.translation:
*那里有一根隐藏的拉杆。
要扳动吗？*

entries.source:
*The lever
won't budge!*
entries.translation:
*拉杆
纹丝不动！*

entries.source: Watching.
entries.translation: 注视。

entries.source: Consume.
entries.translation: 吞噬。

entries.source: Reward.
entries.translation: 奖赏。

entries.source: Feed souls? (5<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 喂食灵魂？ (5<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source:
I welcome thee, my disciple.
Has thou brought any Souls<sprite name="Soul">?
entries.translation:
我欢迎你，我的门徒。
你带来灵魂<sprite name="Soul">了吗？

entries.source:
Tell me thy secrets.
What is it that thou seek?
entries.translation:
告诉我你的秘密。
你究竟在寻找什么？

entries.source:
Remember.
I am always watching thee.
entries.translation:
记住。
我一直注视着你。

entries.source:
Bring me more souls.
Trust me.
There is always more rewards for thee.
entries.translation:
给我带来更多灵魂。
相信我。
奖赏总会更多。

entries.source: Very well.
entries.translation: 很好。

entries.source: Wise choice.
entries.translation: 明智的选择。

entries.source:
I will not upgrade
this trash any further...
entries.translation:
我不会再为这件垃圾
继续升级了……

entries.source: A simple task.
entries.translation: 一项简单的任务。

entries.source:
Such greed?
I expected better.
Nonetheless, a deal is a deal.
entries.translation:
如此贪婪？
我本以为你会更好。
不过交易就是交易。

entries.source: Random Reward (5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 随机奖励 (5灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source: Upgrade Weapon (5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 升级武器 (5灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source: Heal And Repair (5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 治疗并修理 (5灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source: Riches (5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 财富 (5灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source:
You can take one tome.
One tome only!
entries.translation:
你可以拿走一本典籍。
只能拿一本！

entries.source:
And remember to share your
wisdom with others.
entries.translation:
记住，要把你的
智慧分享给他人。

entries.source: Take the bird cage?
entries.translation: 要带走鸟笼吗？

entries.source: Try to snatch the item?
entries.translation: 要试着抢走这件物品吗？

entries.source: Read the glyphs inscribed the mana shrine?
entries.translation: 要阅读刻在法力圣坛上的符文吗？

entries.source:
*Reading the ancient texts,
empowered your magical potency.*
entries.translation:
*阅读古老的文字后，
你的魔力变得更强了。*

entries.source: *You gained [[+1]] maximum mana<sprite name="Mana">.*
entries.translation: *你获得了[[+1]]最大法力<sprite name="Mana">。*

entries.source: Lesson Of True Might
entries.translation: 真力之课

entries.source:
Mastering the Lesson Of True Might
permanently grants you
[[+25% increased damage with non-crits]].
entries.translation:
掌握真力之课
将永久赋予你
[[非暴击伤害提高 +25%]]。

entries.source: Lesson Of True Speed
entries.translation: 真速之课

entries.source:
Mastering the Lesson Of True Speed
permanently grants you
[[+10% movement and attack speed]].
entries.translation:
掌握真速之课
将永久赋予你
[[移速和攻速提高 +10%]]。

entries.source: Lesson Of True Precision
entries.translation: 真准之课

entries.source:
Mastering the Lesson Of True Precision
permanently grants you
+[[10% critical hit chance]].
entries.translation:
掌握真准之课
将永久赋予你
+[[10% 暴击率]]。

entries.source: Greetings.
entries.translation: 你好。

entries.source:
Are you here to
learn ancient combat
techniques?
entries.translation:
你是来
学习古老的战斗
技巧的吗？

entries.source:
I shall teach you one lesson,
but one lesson only.
entries.translation:
我会教你一课，
但只能教一课。

entries.source:
Really?
I might have misjudged
your character.
entries.translation:
真的吗？
看来我误判了
你的为人。

entries.source:
I am not sure you
quite understood the
quintessence of this lesson.
entries.translation:
我不确定你是否
真正理解了
这堂课的精髓。

entries.source:
Maybe you need
more training.
entries.translation:
也许你需要
更多训练。

entries.source:
That was an exceptional
performance.
entries.translation:
表现得非常
出色。

entries.source:
It seems you've mastered
my technique.
entries.translation:
看来你已经掌握了
我的技巧。

entries.source:
Fare well on
your journey.
entries.translation:
在旅途中
一路顺风。

entries.source:
You must decide on
which lesson I shall teach you.
entries.translation:
你必须决定
我该教你哪一课。

entries.source:
Ready up!
Follow my moves!
entries.translation:
准备好！
跟着我的动作！

entries.source:
Do you want to
try again?
entries.translation:
想再
试一次吗？

entries.source: Touch the golden monkey statue?
entries.translation: 要触碰金色的猴子雕像吗？

entries.source:
*You gained [[+1]] luck<sprite name="Luck">
but you also have been cursed<sprite name="Curse">
by the golden monkey.*
entries.translation:
*你获得了[[+1]]幸运<sprite name="Luck">，
但也被金色的猴子
施加了诅咒<sprite name="Curse">。*

entries.source: Try to snatch the Cheese?
entries.translation: 要抢走奶酪吗？

entries.source: *Got it anyways.*
entries.translation: *还是拿到了。*

entries.source: Revive this fossil
entries.translation: 复活这块化石

entries.source: Not this one
entries.translation: 不要这块

entries.source:
"Cherubim Fossil"
"An angelic being
that fell down from
the high heavens."
entries.translation:
“天使化石”
“一个天使般的存在
从至高天堂
坠落而下。”

entries.source:
"Dragon Fossil"
"Most dragons are able to
breath fire."
entries.translation:
“龙化石”
“大多数龙都能
喷出火焰。”

entries.source:
"Hellspawn Fossil"
"A devilish creature
born in the depths
of the burning hells."
entries.translation:
“地狱种化石”
“一个诞生于
燃烧地狱深处的
恶魔生物。”

entries.source:
"Sorrowsworn Fossil"
"A demonic minion that spreads misery
with a pointy spear of shadows."
entries.translation:
“悲恸化石”
“一个散播苦难的恶魔爪牙，
手持一把尖利的暗影长矛。”

entries.source:
"Raptor Fossil"
"These dinosaurs loved to
hunt in packs."
entries.translation:
“迅猛龙化石”
“这些恐龙喜欢
成群捕猎。”

entries.source:
Can't decide?
I understand, all of them were
very interesting creatures.
entries.translation:
决定不了？
我明白，这些生物
都很有意思。

entries.source:
What a coincidence!
I would have chosen the same.
Let's get to work!
entries.translation:
真巧！
我也会选一样的。
我们开始吧！

entries.source:
I can't believe it!
We actually did it!
That was quite the process, huh?
entries.translation:
难以置信！
我们居然真的做到了！
过程相当复杂，对吧？

entries.source:
As promised,
you can keep it.
entries.translation:
如约而至，
它归你了。

entries.source:
I am just so happy
to have had the opportunity
to make use of these
ancient techniques.
entries.translation:
我只是非常高兴
有机会
运用这些
古老的技术。

entries.source:
Thank you.
Without you, this wouldn't
have been possible.
entries.translation:
谢谢你。
没有你，这根本
不可能完成。

entries.source:
Hello there.
By any chance, do
you have a minute of free time?
entries.translation:
你好。
你有空
抽出一点时间吗？

entries.source:
Oh...
That's a pity...
entries.translation:
哦……
真可惜……

entries.source:
Oh! Really?
That's great.
entries.translation:
哦！真的吗？
太好了。

entries.source:
Listen.
I studied these ancient texts and
I think I found out how
to revive a creature.
entries.translation:
听我说。
我研究了这些古老文字，
我想我找到了
复活生物的方法。

entries.source:
I have the materials to
revive one creature.
entries.translation:
我有复活
一只生物所需的材料。

entries.source:
My problem is, that
it can't be done alone.
I need a helping hand.
entries.translation:
问题是，这件事
不能靠我一个人完成。
我需要你的帮助。

entries.source:
If you help me out,
you can choose and keep the creature.
How about that?
entries.translation:
如果你帮我，
就可以选择并留下这只生物。
怎么样？

entries.source:
Aw, come on!
Don't leave me hanging!
entries.translation:
哎，别这样！
别让我干等啊！

entries.source:
Okay okay.
I'll be waiting for you
to choose a fossil.
entries.translation:
好吧好吧。
我会等你
选一块化石。

entries.source:
Would you like to stay
for the night?
<color=grey>[Will reroll tavern visitors.]</color>
entries.translation:
想留宿一晚吗？
<color=grey>[会重新安排酒馆访客。]</color>

想留宿一晚吗？ (5金币<sprite name="Gold">)
<color=grey>[会重新安排酒馆访客。]</color>

entries.source:
Very well.
I hope you have a nice stay!
entries.translation:
好吧。
希望你住得愉快！

entries.source:
People come and go.
The crowd in the tavern,
might be completely different tomorrow.
entries.translation:
人来人往。
酒馆里的客人
明天可能完全不同。

entries.source:
Sorry, you must find another
place to stay tonight.
We have closed tomorrow.
entries.translation:
抱歉，今晚你得
另找住处。
我们明天闭店。

entries.source: Welcome! Can I help you to a drink?
entries.translation: 欢迎！要来杯酒吗？

entries.source:
No worries!
Come back any time.
entries.translation:
别担心！
随时欢迎回来。

entries.source:
I don't see how
you're gonna pay
for that buddy.
entries.translation:
我没看出你
要怎么付钱，
朋友。

entries.source:
Ha-ha! Very well!
Keep in mind there's
plenty more where that came from!
entries.translation:
哈哈！好吧！
记住，这种好东西
还有很多呢！

entries.source:
Woah!
I think you've had enough.
Now I gotta clean up your mess...
entries.translation:
哇！
我觉得你已经喝够了。
现在还得收拾你的烂摊子……

entries.source:
Remember, the light you seek
is already with you.
Go forward, and shine brightly
for all to see.
entries.translation:
记住，你寻找的光
其实一直都在你身边。
继续前行，发出耀眼光芒
让所有人都看见。

entries.source:
You have chosen well.
Let these guide you,
not to fortune, but to understanding.
entries.translation:
你选得很好。
愿它们引导你，
走向理解，而非财富。

entries.source:
Peace be with you.
The world is heavy, isn't it?
But you are never alone.
entries.translation:
愿和平与你同在。
这个世界很沉重，对吧？
但你从来不是孤身一人。

entries.source:
Good day to you!
Would you be interested in
buying a "Purging Stone"?
entries.translation:
祝你今天愉快！
有兴趣买一块“净化石”吗？

entries.source:
Thank you! And remember,
it is only human to commit a sin.
Ti-hi-hi-hi.
entries.translation:
谢谢！记住，
犯错是人之常情。
嘻嘻嘻嘻。

entries.source:
You appear to lack faith.
Let's hope you don't
regret this choice.
entries.translation:
看来你缺乏信仰。
希望你不会
后悔这个选择。

entries.source:
Try to not get
cursed again!
Purging Stones are quite
rare and precious.
entries.translation:
尽量别再
被诅咒了！
净化石相当
稀有而珍贵。

entries.source:
I can feel the darkness inside you.
Poor soul.
I hope you find your way
back to the light.
entries.translation:
我能感到你体内的黑暗。
可怜的灵魂。
希望你能找到
回到光明的路。

entries.source:
I can feel the light inside you.
We fight for the same cause.
Blessed be your path.
entries.translation:
我能感到你体内的光明。
我们为同一个目标而战。
愿你的道路受到祝福。

entries.source:
Hmmm...
Do you want to buy this
"Storm In A Bottle"?
entries.translation:
嗯……
要买这瓶
“风暴之瓶”吗？

entries.source:
Thank god.
I really need some booze...
entries.translation:
谢天谢地。
我真的需要喝点酒……

entries.source:
I understand.
If you change your mind,
let me know.
entries.translation:
我明白。
你改变主意的话，
告诉我一声。

entries.source:
I probably shouldn't do this...
Oh! Hey! You!
Do you want to buy 3 Bombs<sprite name="Bomb">?
entries.translation:
我大概不该这样做……
哦！嘿！你！
要买3个炸弹<sprite name="Bomb">吗？

entries.source:
Hell yeah, brother!
Have a blast!
entries.translation:
当然，兄弟！
炸个痛快！

entries.source:
Aww... really?
You know, it's really fun
to blow stuff up.
Think about it.
entries.translation:
啊……真的吗？
你知道吗，炸东西
真的很有趣。
好好想想吧。

entries.source:
You're the bomb, brother!
Cheers!
entries.translation:
你真是个炸弹，兄弟！
干杯！

entries.source:
I'm so drunk...
I can't even stand up.
entries.translation:
我醉得厉害……
连站都站不起来。

entries.source:
I have decided I'm just
gonna sit here and accept it.
entries.translation:
我决定就这样
坐在这里接受现实。

entries.source: ZzzZZzzzz...
entries.translation: 呼呼ZZzzzz……

entries.source:
Greetings, stranger!
Care to purchase
a "Green Blossom"?
entries.translation:
你好，陌生人！
要买一朵
“绿花”吗？

entries.source:
Many thanks! Remember,
even in the deepest woods,
life finds a way.
Hi-hi-hi-hi.
entries.translation:
多谢！记住，
即使在最深的森林里，
生命也总能找到出路。
嘻嘻嘻嘻。

entries.source:
You seem hesitant.
May the forest's wisdom guide you
in your decision.
entries.translation:
你似乎有些犹豫。
愿森林的智慧指引你
做出决定。

entries.source:
Be mindful as you tread
nature's paths.
Nature's gifts are
a gift, not a given.
entries.translation:
走在自然的道路上
要多加小心。
自然的馈赠是礼物，
不是理所当然。

entries.source:
I sense a shadow within you.
Tread carefully, lost one.
The forest's embrace can still
offer you solace.
entries.translation:
我感到你心中的阴影。
小心前行，迷途者。
森林的怀抱
仍能给你安慰。

entries.source:
Your heart beats in harmony
with nature.
We share the same roots.
May your journey be fruitful.
entries.translation:
你的心跳与自然
和谐一致。
我们拥有相同的根。
愿你的旅途硕果累累。

entries.source:
A real warrior, always
brings some Repair Powder into battle!
Wanna buy some?
entries.translation:
真正的战士总会
带着一些修理粉上战场！
要买点吗？

entries.source:
Ya-ya-ya!
You know what's good!
And so do I, if you know what I mean.
entries.translation:
呀呀呀！
你知道什么是好东西！
我当然也知道。

entries.source:
Whaaaaat?!
I said a REAL warrior anyways!
entries.translation:
什——么？！
我说的是货真价实的战士！

entries.source:
A real warrior always
makes sure their armor
is in tip-top shape!
No slacking!
entries.translation:
真正的战士总会
确保自己的护甲
处于最佳状态！
别偷懒！

entries.source:
What are you looking at?
Buddy.
I know your kind,
don't try anything stupid.
entries.translation:
你在看什么？
朋友。
我知道你这种人，
别打什么馊主意。

entries.source:
I can feel it!
You are a strong, brave
and foremost kind warrior like me!
entries.translation:
我感受到了！
你是个强大、勇敢，
最重要的是善良的战士，和我一样！

entries.source:
Howdy!
My father was a gambling addict.
May he rest in peace.
entries.translation:
你好！
我父亲是个赌徒。
愿他安息。

entries.source:
He left me the farm in
a really bad condition.
entries.translation:
他把农场留给我时，
状况已经糟透了。

entries.source:
He also left me his dice collection.
Would you be interested
in buying some dice?
entries.translation:
他还留下了他的骰子收藏。
你有兴趣
买些骰子吗？

entries.source:
Splendid!
That will help me pay my debts.
entries.translation:
太好了！
这能帮我还债。

entries.source:
Smart choice.
It's better to stay away
from gambling anyways!
entries.translation:
明智的选择。
反正还是远离赌博
比较好！

entries.source:
Howdy!
How's it going?
entries.translation:
你好！
最近怎么样？

entries.source:
Come closer and listen up.
I got a massive deal for you, eh?
Wanna buy some "Illegal Gun Parts"?
entries.translation:
靠近点，听好了。
我给你一笔超划算的交易，嗯？
要买些“非法枪械零件”吗？

entries.source:
You know it!
That's the good stuff!
entries.translation:
当然！
这才是好东西！

entries.source:
Oh...
Do you mind keeping the
little talk we just had
between us?
entries.translation:
哦……
你介意把我们刚才
的小谈话
保密吗？

entries.source: Good stuff, eh?
entries.translation: 好东西，对吧？

entries.source: You seem a bit shady, eh?
entries.translation: 你看起来有点可疑，嗯？

entries.source:
A bit of a hero, aren't you?
Hmmm...
entries.translation:
你是个小英雄，对吧？
嗯……

entries.source:
Your fate is sealed now...
Enjoy the game while you can,
for it plays you just as much.
entries.translation:
你的命运已经封印……
趁还能享受游戏就尽情享受吧，
因为游戏也同样在玩弄你。

entries.source:
Ah-ha-ha-ha!
A bold choice for one so fragile.
Remember, the dice always win in the end.
entries.translation:
啊哈哈哈哈！
如此脆弱的人竟敢做出大胆选择。
记住，骰子最终总会获胜。

entries.source:
Ahh, a coward, I see.
Run along then.
But don't think you can escape me forever...
entries.translation:
啊，一个懦夫，我明白了。
那就快跑吧。
但别以为你能永远逃离我……

entries.source:
Heh-heh-heh...
Naughty children get coal,
and wicked ones get dice.
Which are you?
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿……
淘气的孩子得到煤炭，
坏孩子得到骰子。
你是哪一种？

entries.source:
These aren't just any dice,
ohh no.
<color=#3B3B7A>Obsidian Dice</color> can decide your fate.
Dare to buy some? <color=grey>(x5)</color>
entries.translation:
这可不是普通的骰子，
哦，不是。
<color=#3B3B7A>黑曜石骰子</color>能决定你的命运。
敢买一些吗？ <color=grey>(x5)</color>

entries.source:
Hello!
You look very healthy,
I don't think I can help you.
entries.translation:
你好！
你看起来很健康，
我想我帮不上忙。

entries.source:
Hello!
You look a little roughed up,
need some healing?
<color=grey>[Fully recovers hearts<sprite name="Heart">
and refills flasks.]</color>
entries.translation:
你好！
你看起来有点狼狈，
需要治疗吗？
<color=grey>[完全恢复红心<sprite name="Heart">
并补满药瓶。]</color>

entries.source: Looking better already!
entries.translation: 已经好多了！

entries.source:
Okay, but don't
blame me if you die out there.
entries.translation:
好吧，但要是你死在外面
可别怪我。

entries.source:
All patched up and
ready to go!
Take care out there!
entries.translation:
都处理好了，
可以出发了！
在外面小心！

entries.source:
You look a bit, ill-equipped?
A raggedy bag full of holes!
Want me to patch one up?
entries.translation:
你看起来装备不太齐全？
一个满是破洞的破袋子！
要我补一个吗？

entries.source:
A few stitches and your pocket
will be as good as new!
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
缝几针，你的口袋
就会焕然一新！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Oh, hoarding holes now, are we?
Well, keep your tatters then!
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
哦，原来你在收集破洞，是吗？
那就留着你的破布吧！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
All stitched up!
Now don't go filling it
with too much junk!
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
全都缝好了！
现在别再往里
塞太多垃圾！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
My, aren't we tidy now?
Nothing left for me to fix, off with you!
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
哎呀，现在不是整洁多了吗？
没什么要我修的了，走吧！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
The young people today just
can't hold their drinks
like we could back in our day.
entries.translation:
现在的年轻人
真不会喝酒，
不像我们那时候。

entries.source:
We would drink all night
and not get hangovers.
entries.translation:
我们能喝一整晚
还不会宿醉。

entries.source:
Now, one drink and they're
all over the place!
entries.translation:
现在倒好，喝一杯
就东倒西歪！

entries.source:
Potion Seller,
I need your strongest potions.
entries.translation:
药水商，我需要
你最强的药水。

entries.source:
But I am going into battle!
I need your potions...
entries.translation:
但我要上战场！
我需要你的药水……

entries.source:
How come you sell to them
but not to me?
entries.translation:
为什么你卖给他们
却不卖给我？

entries.source: My potions are too strong for you!
entries.translation: 我的药水对你来说太强了！

entries.source:
Always happy to help!
Come again.
entries.translation:
随时乐意帮忙！
欢迎再来。

entries.source:
Maybe you aren't
strong enough after all...
entries.translation:
看来你终究
还不够强……

entries.source:
I told you.
My potions are too strong for you!
entries.translation:
我说过了。
我的药水对你来说太强了！

entries.source:
Hello there! You seem strong.
Need a "Anger Potion"?
entries.translation:
你好！你看起来很强。
要一瓶“愤怒药水”吗？

entries.source:
Hello there! You seem strong.
Need a "Luck Potion"?
entries.translation:
你好！你看起来很强。
要一瓶“幸运药水”吗？

entries.source:
Hello there! You seem strong.
Need a "Power Potion"?
entries.translation:
你好！你看起来很强。
要一瓶“力量药水”吗？

entries.source:
Hello there! You seem strong.
Need a "Wrath Potion"?
entries.translation:
你好！你看起来很强。
要一瓶“狂怒药水”吗？

entries.source:
Fancy some magic for your quest?
I bring a Fairy Tale Branch
from a land far, far away.
Interested?
entries.translation:
想为你的任务准备些魔法吗？
我带来了一根童话树枝，
来自遥远、遥远的国度。
有兴趣吗？

entries.source:
Magical choice!
This branch could weave some
exciting twists in your story.
Or perhaps, ... ours?
Ti-hi-hi!
entries.translation:
魔法般的选择！
这根树枝能让你的故事
出现令人兴奋的转折。
或者，也许是……我们的故事？
嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Can't decide?
A little magic can lead to
big adventures.
Go on, be enchanted!
entries.translation:
决定不了？
一点魔法就能带来
大冒险。
来吧，接受魔法的召唤！

entries.source:
Remember, every step is
part of your story.
Take a risk once in a while;
who knows where it might lead!
entries.translation:
记住，每一步都是
你故事的一部分。
偶尔冒一次险；
谁知道它会把你带向哪里！

entries.source:
With this branch,
your tale takes a magical turn.
May it lead you to wonders untold.
Safe travels. Ti-hi-hi!
entries.translation:
有了这根树枝，
你的故事将迎来魔法转折。
愿它把你带向未知奇迹。
旅途平安。嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
I sense a shadow in your tale.
But every hero has their trials.
Just don't stray too far from the light.
entries.translation:
我感到了你故事里的阴影。
但每位英雄都有自己的试炼。
只是别离光明太远。

entries.source:
A heart full of magic!
Together, let's weave a tale that's
nothing short of magical.
Shall we?
entries.translation:
你心中充满魔法！
让我们一起编织一个
真正充满魔法的故事。
怎么样？

entries.source:
Use them well, my friend.
And remember:
good deeds often return to us tenfold.
entries.translation:
好好使用它们，我的朋友。
记住：
善行常会十倍回报。

entries.source:
Wonderful!
May these dice guide you wisely
and bring you only the best fortune.
entries.translation:
太棒了！
愿这些骰子明智地指引你，
只带来最好的好运。

entries.source:
Ah, welcome, my friend.
The holiday season is full of blessings
and second chances.
How may I help you?
entries.translation:
啊，欢迎，我的朋友。
节日时节充满祝福
与重新开始的机会。
我能如何帮助你？

entries.source:
I carry a special gift:
<color=#FFC414>Golden Dice</color>, blessed with fortune and grace.
They could bring you a brighter path.
Would you like some? <color=grey>(x3)</color>
entries.translation:
我带来了一份特别的礼物：
<color=#FFC414>黄金骰子</color>，承载着好运与恩典。
它们会为你带来更光明的道路。
要来一些吗？ <color=grey>(x3)</color>

entries.source:
Hello there.
The tavern booze is good
but I also brought my own.
entries.translation:
你好。
酒馆的酒不错，
但我也带了自己的。

entries.source:
You know what,
I'll sell you some.
Want to buy some "Sake"?
entries.translation:
你知道吗，
我可以卖你一些。
要买点“清酒”吗？

entries.source:
It truly does lift
the fighting spirit!
But don't over do it!
entries.translation:
它确实能振奋
战斗精神！
但别喝过量！

entries.source:
Understandable.
After all, you aren't as cool as me.
*sip*
entries.translation:
可以理解。
毕竟你没我这么酷。
*啜饮*

entries.source:
Hoh-hoh-hoh!
I am the real Santa!
Can you believe it?
entries.translation:
呵呵呵！
我是真正的圣诞老人！
你相信吗？

entries.source:
Hey kid...
Mind helping Santa out?
I'll sell ya a "Gift Box", deal?
entries.translation:
嘿，小家伙……
能帮圣诞老人一个忙吗？
我卖你一个“礼物盒”，成交？

entries.source:
Hoh-hoh-hoh!
You saved the christmas spirits!
entries.translation:
呵呵呵！
你拯救了圣诞精灵！

entries.source:
Oh well...
That's depressing to hear.
entries.translation:
好吧……
听到这个真让人沮丧。

entries.source:
Thank you.
That really hit the spot!
*burp*
entries.translation:
谢谢你。
真是帮大忙了！
*嗝*

entries.source:
Got some Souls<sprite name=Soul>?
Listen up!
Want to buy this
Soul Heart<sprite name=Soul_Heart>.
He-he-he!
entries.translation:
有灵魂<sprite name=Soul>吗？
听好了！
要买这个
灵魂之心<sprite name=Soul_Heart>吗？
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
He-he-he-he!
Pleasure making business!
entries.translation:
嘿嘿嘿嘿！
很高兴做成这笔交易！

entries.source:
Come on!
You have no use for Souls<sprite name=Soul>, right?
entries.translation:
来吧！你也用不上灵魂<sprite name=Soul>，
对吧？

entries.source:
Sorry!
No refunds.
That's my policy.
He-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
抱歉！
不退款。
这是我的规矩。
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
The beer here is decent,
but my brew is legendary.
entries.translation:
这里的啤酒还行，
但我的自酿酒可是传说级的。

entries.source:
You seem like a strong lad!
I'll offer you some.
What do you say,
a bottle of Mead?
entries.translation:
你看起来是个强壮的小伙子！
我给你来一些。
怎么样，
来瓶蜂蜜酒？

entries.source:
It warms the warrior's soul!
But moderation is key, friend!
entries.translation:
能温暖战士的灵魂！
但朋友，适量饮用才是关键！

entries.source:
No worries.
Not everyone can match my might.
*gulp*
entries.translation:
别担心。
不是所有人都能匹敌我的力量。
*咕嘟*

entries.source:
Whom do we have here?
A little bit of a rowdy, huh?
I like it.
entries.translation:
我们这里来了谁？
有点吵闹的小家伙，对吧？
我喜欢。

entries.source:
Who are you?
No offense but
you seem a bit wimpy.
Hmph, oh well.
entries.translation:
你是谁？
别介意，不过
你看起来有点弱不禁风。
哼，算了。

entries.source: *You have no weapon equipped.*
entries.translation: *你没有装备武器。*

entries.source: *Equip a weapon to upgrade it.*
entries.translation: *装备武器后才能升级。*

entries.source:
No talk.
Only trade.
entries.translation:
不说话。
只做交易。

entries.source:
Keep your distance.
We are not friends.
entries.translation:
离我远点。
我们不是朋友。

entries.source: Yes.
entries.translation: 是。

entries.source: *You don't have any gold.*
entries.translation: *你没有金币。*

entries.source:
*You don't have
enough gold.*
entries.translation:
*你没有
足够的金币。*

entries.source:
*Requires a spare
//heart<sprite name="Health"> to sacrifice.*
entries.translation:
*需要一颗备用的
//红心<sprite name="Health">才能献祭。*

entries.source:
*You don't have
enough souls.*
entries.translation:
*你没有
足够的灵魂。*

entries.source: *Nothing changed...*
entries.translation: *什么也没改变……*

entries.source: *Nothing happened...*
entries.translation: *什么也没发生……*

entries.source: Take a rest?
entries.translation: 要休息一下吗？

entries.source: *You feel refreshed and relaxed.*
entries.translation: *你感到神清气爽、放松了下来。*

entries.source:
Nye-he-he-he!
Welcome, traveller.
entries.translation:
咿嘻嘻嘻！
欢迎，旅行者。

entries.source:
Want me to knit
something for you?
What's your favorite color,
my dear?
entries.translation:
要我为你
织点什么吗？
你最喜欢什么颜色，
亲爱的？

entries.source:
That's it.
Go on, take it.
It's a gift.
entries.translation:
就是这样。
来，拿去吧。
这是礼物。

entries.source: Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation: 桀嘿嘿嘿！

entries.source:
Ah, yes!
That's a nice color.
I'll get right on it.
entries.translation:
啊，是的！
这个颜色不错。
我马上开始。

entries.source: Eh, I'm fine. Thanks!
entries.translation: 呃，我没事。谢谢！

entries.source:
Are you sure?
It can get frosty
on an adventure!
entries.translation:
你确定吗？
冒险途中可能会
冷得刺骨！

entries.source:
I have been expecting you,
brave soul.
Take this weapon,
it shall aid you on your journey.
entries.translation:
我一直在等你，
勇敢的灵魂。
拿上这件武器，
它会助你踏上旅程。

entries.source:
That's okay.
Come back if you
change your mind.
entries.translation:
没关系。
改变主意的话
随时回来。

entries.source:
*The friendly mushroom hands
you a smaller mushroom.*
entries.translation:
*友善的蘑菇
递给你一株小蘑菇。*

entries.source: Upgrade (20 Gold<sprite name="Gold">)
entries.translation: 升级 (20金币<sprite name="Gold">)

entries.source: Upgrade (25 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
entries.translation: 升级 (25灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)

entries.source:
Hoot, hoot!
Hey you!
Do you know the secret of the moon?
entries.translation:
咕咕！
嘿，你！
你知道月亮的秘密吗？

entries.source:
No?
Perhaps we can discover it on a journey.
Would you like me to join you?
entries.translation:
不知道？
也许我们可以在旅途中发现它。
想让我加入你们吗？

entries.source:
Even if all the stars aligned,
I would never party up with a squirrel.
Hoot, hoot.
entries.translation:
即使群星全都对齐，
我也绝不会和松鼠组队。
咕咕。

entries.source:
Even if all the stars aligned,
I would never party up with a fox.
Hoot, hoot.
entries.translation:
即使群星全都对齐，
我也绝不会和狐狸组队。
咕咕。

entries.source: Hoot. It shall remain a mystery then.
entries.translation: 咕。那就让它继续成为谜团吧。

entries.source:
Splendid!
We shall soar high, wisdom and
moonlight guiding our path.
entries.translation:
太好了！
我们将展翅高飞，
让智慧与月光指引道路。

entries.source:
Hoot, hoot!
What's that?
entries.translation:
咕咕！
那是什么？

entries.source: Hmm, are you a cleric?
entries.translation: 嗯，你是牧师吗？

entries.source:
Good day.
You look reasonably sane!
Need something?
entries.translation:
你好。
你看起来还算神志正常！
需要什么吗？

entries.source:
I sell trinkets.
You might not be able to
afford them though.
entries.translation:
我卖些小饰品。
不过你可能
买不起。

entries.source: Ughh! A cleric?!
entries.translation: 呃！牧师？！

entries.source:
You are not a cleric.
I can smell that a mile away.
entries.translation:
你不是牧师。
隔着老远我就闻得出来。

entries.source:
Good for you...
I don't like their kind.
entries.translation:
对你来说是好事……
我不喜欢他们那种人。

entries.source: Wonderful choice.
entries.translation: 绝妙的选择。

entries.source:
Hopefully I won't be stripping
this off your dead corpse,
later down the line.
entries.translation:
希望以后我不用
从你的尸体上
扒下它。

entries.source:
Welcome to Lucien's Pawn Shop!
Got any equipment or weapons
you're looking to sell?
entries.translation:
欢迎来到卢西恩当铺！
有想出售的装备
或武器吗？

entries.source:
As a collector, I can promise you
that your items will be well
cared for in my collection.
entries.translation:
作为收藏家，我可以保证
你的物品会在我的收藏中
得到妥善照料。

entries.source:
I have a special appreciation for
unique and rare items. Let me know
if you have anything you think might interest me.
entries.translation:
我特别欣赏
独特而稀有的物品。要是有
什么感兴趣的东西请告诉我。

entries.source:
Drop any items you'd like me
to take a look at on the carpet.
entries.translation:
把你想让我看看的物品
放到地毯上。

entries.source:
Welcome to the Hero Hideout!
You are safe here.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到英雄藏身处！
这里很安全。

entries.source:
*The penguin seems eager
for a fight.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅似乎
迫不及待想战斗。*

entries.source:
Challenge this penguin
to a dance battle?
entries.translation:
要向这只企鹅
发起舞蹈对决吗？

entries.source: Try again?
entries.translation: 再试一次？

entries.source:
*The penguin shakes
it's head.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅摇了摇
头。*

entries.source:
*The penguin nods
it's head approvingly.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅赞许地点了点
头。*

entries.source:
*The penguin seems
delighted to have
faced a worthy challenger.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅似乎
很高兴
遇到了值得一战的对手。*

entries.source:
*The penguin hands
you a gift.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅
递给你一件礼物。*

entries.source:
*The penguin seems
still very happy.*
entries.translation:
*企鹅似乎
仍然非常开心。*

entries.source:
Odd place for strangers
to meet, isn't it?
What brings you down here?
entries.translation:
陌生人在这里见面
真是个奇怪的地方，对吧？
你为何来到这里？

entries.source: I think I can help you.
entries.translation: 我想我能帮你。

entries.source: Want a little boost?
entries.translation: 要来一点助力吗？

entries.source:
I understand.
Come back any time
if you change your mind.
entries.translation:
我明白。
改变主意的话
随时回来。

entries.source: This is a one-time remedy.
entries.translation: 这是一次性的药剂。

entries.source: Take care!
entries.translation: 保重！

entries.source: Take this.
entries.translation: 拿着。

entries.source:
Call me crazy, but
you seem a bit clumsy.
entries.translation:
叫我疯子吧，不过
你看起来有点笨手笨脚。

entries.source:
Call me crazy, but
you look a bit lost.
entries.translation:
叫我疯子吧，不过
你看起来有点迷茫。

entries.source:
Call me crazy, but
you appear a bit weak.
entries.translation:
叫我疯子吧，不过
你看起来有点虚弱。

entries.source:
Hello, Potion Seller,
I am going into battle and
I want your strongest potions.
entries.translation:
你好，药水商，
我要上战场，
给我你最强的药水。

entries.source:
My potions are too strong
for you, traveller.
entries.translation:
我的药水太强了，
你承受不了，旅行者。

entries.source: Pull the lever?
entries.translation: 要拉动拉杆吗？

entries.source: Investigate the statue of a ranger?
entries.translation: 要调查游侠雕像吗？

entries.source:
I trade for gold.
Everything's for sale!
entries.translation:
我用金币交易。
什么都有得卖！

entries.source:
I hope you brought
plenty of gold?
entries.translation:
希望你带了
足够多的金币？

entries.source:
Eh? My wares?
Of course they're stolen.
What did you think?
entries.translation:
嗯？我的货物？
当然是偷来的。
你以为呢？

entries.source:
Thank you kindly!
Nee hee hee hee hee!
entries.translation:
谢谢惠顾！
咿嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Ah, thank you,
very much.
Nee hee hee!
entries.translation:
啊，谢谢你，
真的非常感谢。
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
*You cannot upgrade
your weapon beyond the current level
at this type of blacksmith.*
entries.translation:
*你无法把武器
在这类铁匠处升级到
当前等级以上。*

entries.source:
*Your weapon is
already at the MAX level that this
type of blacksmith can upgrade to.*
entries.translation:
*你的武器
已经达到这类铁匠
能升级到的最高等级。*

entries.source:
It seems a weird item is
placed between the pages and used
as a sort of bookmark.
Take the item?
entries.translation:
似乎有件奇怪的物品
夹在书页之间当作书签。
要拿走这件物品吗？

entries.source: *You feel watched.*
entries.translation: *你感到有人在注视你。*

entries.source: Sleep in the blue bed?
entries.translation: 睡在蓝色的床上吗？

entries.source:
*Better not overstay
my welcome.*
entries.translation:
*最好别再逗留
以免打扰主人。*

entries.source: Sleep in the green bed?
entries.translation: 睡在绿色的床上吗？

entries.source: Sleep in the red bed?
entries.translation: 睡在红色的床上吗？

entries.source: *You feel well rested.*
entries.translation: *你感到精神饱满。*

entries.source:
*You permanently gained
[[+1]] maximum mana<sprite name="Mana">.*
entries.translation:
*你永久获得了
[[+1]]最大法力<sprite name="Mana">。*

entries.source:
*You permanently gained
[[+1]] stamina<sprite name="Stamina">.*
entries.translation:
*你永久获得了
[[+1]]体力<sprite name="Stamina">。*

entries.source:
*You permanently gained
[[+1]] heart<sprite name="Heart"> container.*
entries.translation:
*你永久获得了
[[+1]]红心<sprite name="Heart">容器。*

entries.source: Investigate the rune stone?
entries.translation: 要调查符文石吗？

entries.source:
You cannot comprehend
the arcane nature of the rune stone.
entries.translation:
你无法理解
符文石的奥秘本质。

entries.source:
The rune stone
recognizes your potency
and enhanced your abilities.
entries.translation:
符文石认可你的力量，
并
强化了你的能力。

entries.source:
Hello there.
Looking for any rare
scriptures in particular?
entries.translation:
你好。
在找什么特别的
稀有典籍吗？

entries.source:
What gives me the right
to sell these ancient texts?
entries.translation:
我凭什么有权
出售这些古老文字？

entries.source:
Well for one, I went
through all the trouble to
sift through ALL books
in this forsaken library!
entries.translation:
首先，我可是费尽力气
翻遍了这座该死图书馆里的
所有书！

entries.source:
It's not an easy task
to find a quiet place to read
in this library.
entries.translation:
在这座图书馆里
找个安静地方读书
可不容易。

entries.source:
One might think that's
what a library is built for.
Seems like this place is more like
an amusement park for ghosts and specters!
entries.translation:
人们也许以为
图书馆就是为此而建。
但这里更像
鬼魂与幽灵的游乐园！

entries.source: I've read that one.
entries.translation: 我读过那本。

entries.source: I've read that one too.
entries.translation: 那本我也读过。

entries.source: And that one too.
entries.translation: 那本也是。

entries.source: Be not afraid.
entries.translation: 不要害怕。

entries.source: A new master!
entries.translation: 新的主人！

entries.source: The new keeper of order!
entries.translation: 新的秩序守护者！

entries.source: Chosen by the shadows!
entries.translation: 影子选中的人！

entries.source: We serve your highness!
entries.translation: 我们为您效劳，殿下！

entries.source: Take seat, your highness.
entries.translation: 请入座，殿下。

entries.source: My liege. *bows*
entries.translation: 我的陛下。*鞠躬*

entries.source: My lord. *bows*
entries.translation: 我的主人。*鞠躬*

entries.source: We welcome you.
entries.translation: 欢迎您的到来。

entries.source:
I trade for souls.
It's my duty.
entries.translation:
我用灵魂交易。
这是我的职责。

entries.source:
Not every soul finds its
way naturally.
It's our job to help.
entries.translation:
并不是每个灵魂
都能自然地找到归宿。
帮助它们是我们的工作。

entries.source:
The shadows whisper...
Leading souls...
entries.translation:
影子在低语……
引领着灵魂……

entries.source:
I am a Knight of
The Order Of The Silver Flying Dragon!
Show me your weapon, traveller!
entries.translation:
我是银飞龙骑士团的骑士！
让我看看
你的武器，旅行者！

entries.source:
I doubt you'll be
making it very far.
entries.translation:
我怀疑你
能走多远。

entries.source: Into battle!
entries.translation: 投入战斗！

entries.source:
Yikes!
Not the best weapon.
You should really try to find something better.
entries.translation:
哎呀！
这武器不怎么样。
你真的该找件更好的。

entries.source:
Magnificent!
Such an awesome weapon!
Love it!
entries.translation:
华丽！
这武器太棒了！
我喜欢！

entries.source:
Busted!
Where did you even find this monstrosity of a weapon!
Seriously impressive!
entries.translation:
厉害！
你到底从哪找到这件怪物般的武器？
真是令人印象深刻！

entries.source:
Wow!
Count me impressed!
That weapon is quite rare!
entries.translation:
哇！
我可真佩服你！
这武器相当稀有！

entries.source:
I have faith in you.
Take this little token of gratitude!
entries.translation:
我相信你。
收下这点小小的谢意！

entries.source:
Pray to the statue
of the Goddess of Sin?
entries.translation:
要向罪恶女神的雕像
祈祷吗？

entries.source:
*You feel the Goddess of Sin
watching over you.*
entries.translation:
*你感到罪恶女神
正在注视着你。*

entries.source:
*You gained [[50% reduced]] chance of
curse<sprite name="Curse"> taking effect.*
entries.translation:
*你获得了[[降低 50%]]
诅咒<sprite name="Curse">生效的几率。*

entries.source:
Oh, hello there!
We haven't had a visitor in such a long time.
I'm James.
entries.translation:
哦，你好！
已经很久没有访客了。
我叫詹姆斯。

entries.source: So, how's it going?
entries.translation: 最近过得怎么样？

entries.source:
Ah, yes.
That's the thing about
being undead, isn't it?
Time just sort of blends together.
entries.translation:
啊，是啊。
不死生物就是这样，对吧？
时间总是
不知不觉混在一起。

entries.source:
Wait a minute!
I asked the visitor how's it going!
Not you!
entries.translation:
等一下！
我问的是访客过得怎么样！
又不是问你！

entries.source:
Man, I still remember being alive.
Good old times.
entries.translation:
伙计，我还记得活着的时候。
那段日子真不错。

entries.source:
See ya around!
Or not.
entries.translation:
回头见！
也可能再也不见。

entries.source:
Yes, it's been ages.
Nice to meet you.
I'm Lee!
entries.translation:
是啊，已经过了很久。
很高兴认识你。
我是李！

entries.source:
I'm not sure I remember
what it feels like to be
anything other than a skeleton.
entries.translation:
我不太确定自己还记得
除了骷髅之外
其他形态是什么感觉。

entries.source:
Also it doesn't really make
sense to sit at a bonfire
that isn't lit.
entries.translation:
而且，坐在
没有点燃的篝火旁
也没什么意义。

entries.source:
I mean can't you see?
They are clearly doing great.
entries.translation:
我的意思是，你没看见吗？
他们显然过得很好。

entries.source:
Hey visitor, this is for you.
We got no use for it.
Thanks for sticking around.
entries.translation:
嘿，访客，这是给你的。
我们用不上它。
谢谢你愿意留下来。

entries.source:
Hey James, do you remember Rachel?
Whatever happened to her, huh!
entries.translation:
嘿，詹姆斯，你还记得瑞秋吗？
她后来怎么样了，嗯！

entries.source: Wake the sleeping bear?
entries.translation: 要叫醒睡着的熊吗？

entries.source: Rrroooar!
entries.translation: 吼——嗷！

entries.source: *The forge doesn't talk.*
entries.translation: *这座熔炉不会说话。*

entries.source: *A cold sweat rolls down your forehead.*
entries.translation: *一阵冷汗顺着你的额头滑下。*

entries.source: *What do you want to do?*
entries.translation: *你想做什么？*

entries.source: *The blue flames mock your intent.*
entries.translation: *蓝色火焰嘲弄着你的意图。*

entries.source: *The blue flames seem amused.*
entries.translation: *蓝色火焰似乎很开心。*

entries.source: *The blue flames gleefully dance.*
entries.translation: *蓝色火焰欢快地舞动着。*

entries.source: *The blue flames burst in heat. They seem excited.*
entries.translation: *蓝色火焰迸发出热量。它们似乎很兴奋。*

entries.source: *The blue flames flicker with purpose.*
entries.translation: *蓝色火焰带着目的闪烁。*

entries.source:
I am the Soul Peddler.
I trade for souls.
entries.translation:
我是灵魂商人。
我用灵魂交易。

entries.source:
Gold is temporary!
I have no need for it!
entries.translation:
金币只是暂时的！
我不需要它！

entries.source:
Ever seen the flame?
It's magnificent.
I'd do everything to gain its blessings.
entries.translation:
见过那团火焰吗？
它美得惊人。
我愿付出一切来获得它的祝福。

entries.source: Thank you for the Souls!
entries.translation: 谢谢你的灵魂！

entries.source:
More! More!
I need more Souls!
entries.translation:
更多！更多！
我还需要更多灵魂！

entries.source:
Intruder detected.
Initiating defense protocol I.
entries.translation:
发现入侵者。
启动防御协议 I。

entries.source:
Intruder detected.
Initiating defense protocol II.
entries.translation:
发现入侵者。
启动防御协议 II。

entries.source:
Intruder detected.
Initiating defense protocol III.
entries.translation:
发现入侵者。
启动防御协议 III。

entries.source:
Danger!
Soul siphoning operation
at risk.
Heightening defensive measures.
entries.translation:
危险！
灵魂虹吸行动
面临风险。
提高防御措施。

entries.source:
I welcome you, traveler.
I come from the shadow planes.
Are you interested in my wares?
entries.translation:
欢迎你，旅行者。
我来自影界。
对我的货物感兴趣吗？

entries.source:
The shadows have been quieter lately.
The essence flows differently.
What's the disturbance?
We don't know.
entries.translation:
最近影子安静了些。
本质的流动也变了。
发生了什么干扰？
我们不知道。

entries.source:
All souls you spend here
whisper directly back into the shadows.
A curious exchange, wouldn't you think?
entries.translation:
你在这里花费的所有灵魂
都会直接回到影子中。
这是一种奇妙的交换，不是吗？

entries.source:
In the shadows,
there is solace.
entries.translation:
在影界，
这里便是安宁。

entries.source:
Every decision casts
its own shadow.
entries.translation:
每个决定
都会投下自己的影子。

entries.source: May the shadows guide thee.
entries.translation: 愿影子引导你。

entries.source: We thank you.
entries.translation: 感谢你。

entries.source: A quiet exchange, a silent accord.
entries.translation: 安静的交易，无声的契约。

entries.source: Your patronage is kindly noted.
entries.translation: 我们已记下你的惠顾。

entries.source: Feed ... me ... souls ...

Feed Souls? (5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">)
<color=grey>Allows exchanging trait
for a new one.</color>
<color=red>Cannot be cancelled!</color>
entries.translation:
喂食灵魂？ (5灵魂<sprite name="Soul">)
<color=grey>将特质
替换为新的特质。</color>
<color=red>无法取消！</color>

entries.source:
M-meh.
Not interested in you.
entries.translation:
呃呃。
对你没兴趣。

entries.source:
You seem to not meet
the Soul Vessels requirements.
<color=grey>(Requires to have at least 2 traits and 5 Souls<sprite name="Soul">.)</color>
entries.translation:
看来你不符合
灵魂容器的要求。
<color=grey>（至少需要2个特质和5个灵魂<sprite name="Soul">。）</color>

entries.source:
Hello. I sell spice.
You must know, they
are not ordinary spices though.
entries.translation:
你好。我卖香料。
你应该知道，它们
可不是普通香料。

entries.source:
Usual resins don't last very long.
My magical spices, will
last you a lifetime.
entries.translation:
普通树脂的效果不会持续太久。
我的魔法香料
能伴你一生。

entries.source:
I travel around the desert,
to sell spices to ambitious
adventurers like you!
entries.translation:
我在沙漠各处旅行，
把香料卖给
像你这样有抱负的冒险者！

entries.source:
That's a spicy one!
Ho-ho-ho!
entries.translation:
这香料真够劲！
呵呵呵！

entries.source: My favorite kind!
entries.translation: 我最喜欢这种！

entries.source:
Alo!
You don't have any
spare nuts by any chance?
entries.translation:
嗨！
你碰巧有
多余的坚果吗？

entries.source:
No?
Do you think you'll find any on your adventure?
Can I tag along?
entries.translation:
没有？
你觉得冒险时会找到吗？
我能跟你一起吗？

entries.source:
Even for all the nuts of the
forest I wouldn't team up with a fox.
Sorry!
entries.translation:
就算森林里有所有坚果，
我也不会和狐狸组队。
抱歉！

entries.source:
Even for all the nuts of the
forest I wouldn't team up with an owl.
Sorry!
entries.translation:
就算森林里有所有坚果，
我也不会和猫头鹰组队。
抱歉！

entries.source: Aw! That's a bummer...
entries.translation: 啊！真扫兴……

entries.source:
Really?
I promise, this will be
one nutty adventure!
entries.translation:
真的吗？
我保证，这会是
一场疯狂的冒险！

entries.source:
Huh!
Something's buried here!
entries.translation:
嗯！
这里埋着什么东西！

entries.source: *The crevice closed.*
entries.translation: *裂缝闭合了。*

entries.source:
There is something hidden
in the crevice.
Take it?
entries.translation:
裂缝里藏着什么东西。
要拿走吗？

entries.source: Hello, brave adventurer!
entries.translation: 你好，勇敢的冒险者！

entries.source:
Will you take my offspring
on a glorious adventure?
entries.translation:
你愿意带我的孩子
踏上荣耀的冒险吗？

entries.source:
I have high hopes!
Make me proud!
entries.translation:
我对你抱有很高的期望！
别让我失望！

entries.source:
I see you've decided for another.
That is fine, I shall wait for an
even stronger adventurer!
entries.translation:
我看出你选了另一个。
没关系，我会等待
更强的冒险者！

entries.source:
Ever got this feeling,
that somebody is watching you?
entries.translation:
你是否有过这种感觉，
好像有人正在注视你？

entries.source: Everything hurts so much more.
entries.translation: 一切都疼得厉害。

entries.source:
I feel like
I am close to death.
entries.translation:
我感觉自己
离死亡不远了。

entries.source:
My final day...
Inching closer every minute...
entries.translation:
我的最后一天……
每分每秒都在靠近……

entries.source:
Take this.
I've had enough.
entries.translation:
拿着这个。
我受够了。

entries.source: Pray at the sunlight altar?
entries.translation: 要在阳光祭坛前祈祷吗？

entries.source:
*You feel the goddess of
sunlight shining upon the
path ahead of you.
entries.translation:
*你感到阳光女神
照耀着前方的
道路。

entries.source: *You've chosen the Sunlight's Path.*
entries.translation: *你选择了阳光之路。*

entries.source: Take the bombs?
entries.translation: 要拿走炸弹吗？

entries.source: Take the dynamite?
entries.translation: 要拿走炸药吗？

entries.source:
Ey!
Don't empty the tank!
Leave some for the rest of the club.
entries.translation:
嘿！
别把水箱掏空！
给俱乐部其他人留一些。

entries.source:
It's a small aquarium!
We gotta keep the population
under control!
entries.translation:
这是个小水族箱！
我们得控制
种群数量！

entries.source: Which symbol to draw on the floor?
entries.translation: 要在地上画哪个符号？

entries.source: *You feel exhausted.*
entries.translation: *你感到精疲力竭。*

entries.source:
*Cold winds try to get hold of you!*
Let them take you?
entries.translation:
*冷风试图侵入你的身体！*
要让它们带走你吗？

entries.source: *You feel watched.*
entries.translation: *你感到有人在注视你。*

entries.source:
*Something is still draining your life force.*
Try to resist?
entries.translation:
*有什么东西还在吸取你的生命力。*
要抵抗吗？

entries.source: *Something dark is holding you back.*
entries.translation: *某种黑暗正阻拦着你。*

entries.source:
*The material world
calling you.*
Let it drag you back?
entries.translation:
*物质世界
在呼唤你。*
要让它把你拖回去吗？

entries.source:
*You feel the lingering presence
of death around you.*
entries.translation:
*你感到死亡
残留在身边的气息。*

entries.source:
*The aura of death is
as present as ever.*
Ignore it?
entries.translation:
*死亡的气息
一如既往地浓烈。*
要无视它吗？

entries.source: Take seat on the throne?
entries.translation: 要坐上王座吗？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 10/10
Did you know, that attribute points
grant small bonuses to stats?
Strength grants damage. Dexterity grants attack speed
and Intelligence grants critical hit chance.
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 10/10
你知道吗，属性点
会为属性带来小幅加成？
力量提高伤害。敏捷提高攻击速度，
智力提高暴击率。

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 1/10
Did you know, any time a little clover or skull icon
appears it means the outcome has been
affected by Luck or Curse!
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 1/10
你知道吗，每当出现小三叶草或骷髅图标，
就表示结果受到了
幸运或诅咒的影响！

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 2/10
Did you know, proficiencies increase
the scaling of a weapon that scales
with that attribute type by one tier?
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 2/10
你知道吗，熟练度会让
与该属性类型相关的武器
获得更高一阶的属性成长？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 3/10
Did you know, that it is said,
that machines are weak to bombs?
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 3/10
你知道吗，据说
机械敌人怕炸弹？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 4/10
Did you know, you can explode
Treasure Chests, Shrines, Altars and
Slot Machines with bombs?
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 4/10
你知道吗，炸弹可以引爆
宝箱、圣坛、祭坛和
老虎机？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 5/10
Did you know, that
all potion effects are
unique and don't stack?
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 5/10
你知道吗，
所有药水效果
都各不相同且不会叠加？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 6/10
Did you know, locked cellars are probably
a hidden stash of somebody?
You better prepare 2 keys in
case they were extra careful about
locking their stuff away!
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 6/10
你知道吗，上锁的地窖
可能是某人的隐藏储藏室？
最好准备2把钥匙，
以防他们把东西锁得特别严！

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 7/10
Did you know, purple projectiles
will curse you with a random curse!
Also, green projectiles often inflict poison.
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 7/10
你知道吗，紫色投射物
会用随机诅咒诅咒你！
另外，绿色投射物经常施加中毒。

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 8/10
Did you know, attunement
means that you have to equip
the item for a few rooms before
its effects start working?
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 8/10
你知道吗，调谐
意味着你必须装备
该物品几个房间，
它的效果才会生效？

entries.source:
Tips For Adventurers 9/10
Did you know, most enemies and even bosses
have a weakness to a damage type?
Knowing weaknesses can be
handy when in possession of infusion consumables!
entries.translation:
冒险者小贴士 9/10
你知道吗，大多数敌人甚至首领
都对某种伤害类型有弱点？
掌握弱点后，手中的灌注药剂
会非常有用！

entries.source:
"Tips For Drinkers 1/1"
The maximum amount of
"Tipsiness" you can endure,
is determined by your total
amount of hearts<sprite name="Heart">!
entries.translation:
“饮酒者小贴士 1/1”
你能承受的最大
“醉意”
取决于你的红心<sprite name="Heart">
总数！

entries.source: Here lies: Omatuo the Sage.
entries.translation: 这里埋葬着：智者奥马图。

entries.source: Here lies: Iona the Pathfinder.
entries.translation: 这里埋葬着：探路者伊欧娜。

entries.source: The tomb will not open.
entries.translation: 墓穴不会打开。

entries.source: Open the tomb?
entries.translation: 要打开墓穴吗？

entries.source: Here lies: Retra the Barbarian.
entries.translation: 这里埋葬着：野蛮人雷特拉。

entries.source:
Do not be afraid.
I am friendly!
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
别害怕。
我是友善的！
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Have you seen my dear julia?
Oh, I miss her so much...
entries.translation:
你见过我亲爱的朱莉娅吗？
啊，我好想她……

entries.source:
Got any spare bones for sale?
Nye-he-he-he!
entries.translation:
有多余的骨头要卖吗？
咿嘻嘻嘻！

entries.source:
Thank you.
Come back soon.
entries.translation:
谢谢你。
欢迎再来。

entries.source:
Excellent!
Come again!
entries.translation:
太棒了！
欢迎再来！

entries.source: UNDER CONSTRUCTION
entries.translation: 施工中

entries.source: Throw 1 Gold<sprite name="Gold"> into the well?
entries.translation: 要往井里投入1枚金币<sprite name="Gold">吗？

entries.source:
*You got a feeling it's
time to stop throwing
gold into a random well.*
entries.translation:
*你有种感觉，
是时候停止
往随机的井里扔金币了。*

entries.source:
Which doctor am I?
The Witch Doctor am I.
entries.translation:
我是哪位医生？
我是女巫医生。

entries.source:
The heart of magic is nature.
The nature of hearts is magic.
entries.translation:
魔法的核心是自然。
心灵的本质是魔法。

entries.source:
The jungle provides materials!
Perfect for making potions and magic!
entries.translation:
丛林会提供材料！
非常适合制作药水与魔法！

entries.source:
Stay safe,
this is a dangerous place.
entries.translation:
注意安全，
这里很危险。

entries.source:
Thank you
and come again.
entries.translation:
谢谢你，
欢迎再来。

entries.source: Investigate the statue of a wizard?
entries.translation: 要调查法师雕像吗？
